formulas.ascii: R(b*w)<=R(t-origin)<R((b+1)*w); slot=cell*bucketCount+b; counts[slot]=number of accepted rows (Int64: b=(t-origin) div width).
y[i]=0 or 1 after booleanizing inputs by !=0; op is and, or, xor (odd parity), difference (first AND NOT every remaining input), or not (one input).
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.

o[i]=exclusive uint32 scan(flags); if flags[i]!=0 and o[i] is in output capacity, y[o[i]]=x[i]. count=(o[n-1]+min(flags[n-1],1)) mod 2^32, empty=0. Dense stable compaction requires binary flags; raw nonbinary flags leave gaps.

snapshots.name: first
snapshots.meaning: researchGrade at the earliest timestamp of the slot; NaN for an empty slot.

snapshots.name: last
snapshots.meaning: researchGrade at the latest timestamp of the slot; NaN for an empty slot.

snapshots.name: occupiedIds
snapshots.meaning: Only the first occupiedCount entries are slot ids; remaining entries are unused.

sourceLines: // WGSL rejects NaN constants, so build one from a runtime bit pattern.
// Correct the estimate with correctly rounded products: one step down, then one step up.
minOut[minOutOffset + index] = select(nan, decodeOrderedKey(minKeys[minKeysOffset + index]), isOccupied);
maxOut[maxOutOffset + index] = select(nan, decodeOrderedKey(maxKeys[maxKeysOffset + index]), isOccupied);
firstOut[firstOutOffset + index] = select(nan, values[valuesOffset + firstRows[firstRowsOffset + index]], isOccupied);
lastOut[lastOutOffset + index] = select(nan, values[valuesOffset + lastRows[lastRowsOffset + index]], isOccupied);
outputValues[OUTPUT_OFFSET + index] = outputValues[OUTPUT_OFFSET + index] + offsets[OFFSETS_OFFSET + index / 256u];
